description:
Ukrainian consumer price index figures over a period range, newest first.

This is Derzhstat's own consumer price index, not a producer price index and not
the NBU's mixed inflation series. The distinction matters: the month-on-month
series (`base_period` PREV_MONTH) is what Article 625(2) of the Civil Code is
computed from.

An index of 100.0 means no change against its base. Omitting `base_period`
returns every base for each period, which is rarely what a calculation wants.

date_from.description: Inclusive lower bound: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

limit.description: Max rows to return (0-500); 0 returns the count alone.
